HOUSING AUTHORITY MINUTES - 04/04/17 - 7PM
HOUSING AUTHORITY MINUTES - 04/04/17 - 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
APRIL 04, 2017
7:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 132
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR HOFBAUER, COMMISSIONERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, BISHOP, BROWN, AND VACANT
3. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S):
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
4. CONSENT CALENDAR – PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
5. CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1 Approve: 1) funding for the rehabilitation of vacant units, and for funding of the rehabilitation and replacement reserves for the Housing Authority properties; La Quinta Apartments, Summerwood Apartments, Park Vista Apartments and Impressions Apartments; and 2) authorize the Executive Director or his designee to execute all necessary documents and take all necessary actions to implement. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
5.1
5.2 Approve: 1) an Amended and Restated Disposition and Development Agreement with CAC West, L.P., Agreement A-5130; a) modifying the terms of the loan of Housing Authority funds; b) extending the lease for CAC West, L.P. to not more than 99 years; and 2) authorize the Executive Director or his designee to a) negotiate such changes to the agreement, approved by legal counsel, as are needed to satisfy reasonable lender and investor requirements (other than the amount of the Housing Authority assistance); and b) execute all necessary documents and take all necessary and appropriate actions. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
5.2
5.2 Attachment
5.3 Approve the Minutes from previous meetings held on January 4, 2017 (7pm) and February 1, 2017 (5pm). (Staff Reference: Authority Secretary Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings as on all items listed under this Consent Calendar. (Voice Vote â€“ Requires a majority to approve.)
5.3
6. PUBLIC HEARING:
6.1 Public Hearing to hear public comment and 1) adopt Resolution HA 2017-002 approving: a) an Affordable Housing Agreement between the Housing Authority of the City of Palmdale and Habitat for Humanity of San Fernando/Santa Clarita Valleys, Inc., Agreement A-5078; b) the sale of the property, APN 3009-001-900, from the Housing Authority of the City of Palmdale to Habitat for Humanity of San Fernando/Santa Clarita Valleys, Inc.; c) a loan of $2,800,000 to Habitat for Humanity of San Fernando/Santa Clarita Valleys, Inc. by the Housing Authority of the City of Palmdale; and 2) authorize the Executive Director or his designee to execute all necessary documents and take all necessary actions to implement the agreement. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
6.1a RESOLUTION NO. HA 2017-002, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING AN AFFORDABLE HOUSING AGREEMENT WITH HABITAT FOR HOUSING SAN FERNANDO/SANTA CLARITA VALLEYS, INC. AND AUTHORIZING ITS IMPLEMENTATION.
Staff Recommendation: Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote – Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Resolution No. HA 2017-002. (Voice Vote – Requires a majority to adopt.)
6.1

8. ADJOURNMENT.
